periodic_middle: Gaussian periodic low-frequency sum plus analytic isolated high-frequency tail; omitted high-frequency cross interactions

production_numerics.contact_linear_system: two 17N linear FGMRES stages with fixed stage contact forces
production_numerics.contact_nonlinear_solver: none; explicit Heun predictor-corrector with objective history transport

contact_model: Current-stage overlap/sliding/rolling forces; objective Heun histories; no implicit contact or endpoint-force iteration

contact_trial.basis: numerical contact penalties; overlap below 5% and case-specific stiffness/time-step refinement required

initialization: geometric random insertion and growth/FIRE or aligned preparation; actual spheroid periodic clearance >=0
scope: Regularization and contact conventions extended to spheroids; full hydrodynamic operator is not an exact Mari/Singh LF-DEM reproduction
validation_scope: AR1 N500 through 120 microseconds; AR1/2/5 two-particle time refinement; not long-strain certification
